column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for virtual_idol idol entity registration. PK = virtualidols(Entity_Reg).
TEXT. Official name or stage name of the virtual_idol idol character.
TEXT. Type or category classification of the virtual_idol idol (e.g., vtuber, AI idol).
TEXT. Official debut date when the virtual_idol idol first appeared publicly.
TEXT. Associated agency, company, or group managing the virtual_idol idol.
TEXT. Primary genre or content category the virtual_idol idol specializes in.
TEXT. Primary language used by the virtual_idol idol for content and communication.
